Class QueuePutStrategy

java.lang.Object
NetStrategies.QueuePutStrategy
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCheck
Direct Known Subclasses:
EDDStrategy, EDDStrategyPriority, HeadStrategy, HeadStrategyPriority, LEPTStrategy, LEPTStrategyPriority, LJFStrategy, LJFStrategyPriority, RandStrategy, RandStrategyPriority, SEPTStrategy, SEPTStrategyPriority, SJFStrategy, SJFStrategyPriority, SRPTStrategy, SRPTStrategyPriority, TailStrategy, TailStrategyPriority
public abstract class QueuePutStrategy extends Object implements AutoCheck
Use this class to implement a specific queue put strategy. A queue put strategy is a rule which adds a job to a queue.
